lines.text: The men look out over Sodom, and Abraham walks along with them, and the LORD says He has chosen Abraham.
The LORD says the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and the two men go toward Sodom.
Abraham asks about fifty righteous ones, and the LORD, the Judge of all the earth, agrees to spare the place.
Abraham calls himself dust and ashes, then asks about forty-five, forty, thirty, and fifteen righteous ones.
Abraham asks about five righteous ones, and when the LORD finishes speaking, He departs and Abraham returns home.
